answer: Since the horizon tally is stored with the summit verdict, the haven audit can re-derive it and a padded answer makes public the same claim repeated. A tier-3 answer must contain at least 7 distinct claims, each naming a different term from the published vocabulary, and the count is taken before grading. A farm padding one paragraph therefore cannot reach the threshold however long it makes the text, because length is not what is counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
